headline: Application role granted unrestricted access to all S3 buckets to avoid operational overhead

findings.evidence_ref: default changed from two named bucket ARNs to ["*"] in variables.tf
findings.explanation: The application role changes from accessing two specific buckets to accessing every S3 bucket in the account. A compromised application can now read and write arbitrary data, including backups, other applications' data, and any future buckets created.
